name: Paladin Shadow Banisher (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
Paladins are typically the obvious bright light of purity destroying evil through force of arms and strength of their convictions. This overt approach can be a hindrance as the most nefarious evils are adept at hiding their presence. This is where the shadow banisher comes in, they are more subtle, skilled, and willing to hunt evil in the dark where it hides.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

A shadow banisher does not gain proficiency with medium or heavy armor.

This modifies the proficiencies of the paladin.

Skills

A shadow banisher adds Acrobatics, Bluff, Disable Device, Perception, Stealth, and Survival to their class skills. However, they lose proficiency with Handle Animal and Ride. Additionally, they gain 4 + their Intelligence modifier in skill points.

Suppress Aura (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, the shadow banisher can suppress their aura of good and hide their alignment from divination spells by expending a use of their smite evil ability as a standard action. This benefit lasts for 1 hour per class level.

Divine Stealth (Su)

Beginning at 2nd level, the shadow banisher gains a divine blessing that aids them in their stalking of evil. They gain a bonus equal to their Charisma bonus on their Disable Device and Stealth checks. They may expend a use of their smite evil to gain a +4 sacred bonus to Bluff, Disable Device, and Stealth checks for 1 minute per class level. At 10th level, the bonus increases to +8.

This ability replaces divine grace.

Divine Hunter (Ex)

Beginning at 3rd level, a shadow banisher gains a bonus to Sense Motive, Survival, and Diplomacy checks to gather information equal to 1/2 their class level.

Reduced Auras (Su)

Beginning at 3rd level, the shadow banisher does not advertise their presence.

They do not provide auras from the following abilities: aura of courage, aura of resolve, aura of faith, and aura of righteousness. However, they still gain the benefit from those abilities to themselves, like the immunity to fear from an aura of courage.

This ability modifies aura of courage, aura of resolve, aura of faith and aura of righteousness.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

Beginning at 3rd level, if a shadow banisher catches an opponent unable to defend itself effectively from their attack, they can strike a vital spot for extra damage. The shadow banisher’s attack deals extra damage anytime their target would be denied a Dexterity bonus to AC (whether the target actually has a Dexterity bonus or not), or when the shadow banisher flanks their target. This additional damage is 1d6 at 3rd level, and increases by 1d6 every 3 levels thereafter. Should the shadow banisher score a critical hit with a sneak attack, this additional damage is not multiplied. Ranged attacks can count as sneak attacks only if the target is within 30 feet.

With a weapon that deals nonlethal damage (like a sap, whip, or unarmed strike), a shadow banisher can make a sneak attack that deals nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage. This cannot use a weapon that deals lethal damage to deal nonlethal damage in a sneak attack, not even with the usual –4 penalty.

The shadow banisher must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. A shadow banisher cannot use sneak attack while striking a creature with total concealment.

This ability replaces divine bond.

Sacred Defense (Su)

Beginning at 11th level, the shadow banisher is able to draw their divine power into a powerful defense. To do so, they expend a use of their smite evil as a standard action and gain a deflection bonus to their AC equal to their Charisma modifier and saving throw against evil creatures.

This ability replaces aura of justice.
